gloss: lumbar vertebrae; the lower back bones

definitions.explanation: The five vertebrae of the lower back, between the chest vertebrae and the pelvis. Familiar to most people from back pain, disc problems, and compression fractures.

examples.japanese: {腰椎|ようつい}を{骨折|こっせつ}した。
{腰椎|ようつい}ヘルニアの{手術|しゅじゅつ}を{受|う}けた。
examples.english: I had surgery for a lumbar disc herniation.

examples.japanese: {腰|こし}の{痛|いた}みが{長|なが}く{続|つづ}くので、{腰椎|ようつい}のMRIを{撮|と}ることになった。
examples.english: Since the lower back pain has continued for a long time, they decided to do an MRI of my lumbar spine.

notes:
A medical term, but common in everyday conversation about back trouble because lower-back problems are so widespread.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {腰椎|ようつい}ヘルニア: lumbar disc herniation
- {腰椎|ようつい}{圧迫|あっぱく}{骨折|こっせつ}: lumbar compression fracture
- {腰椎|ようつい}{麻酔|ますい}: spinal anesthesia
- {腰椎|ようつい}を{痛|いた}める: to injure one's lumbar spine

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {頚椎|けいつい}: cervical vertebrae — the neck section of the same spine
- {背骨|せぼね}: the backbone — the everyday word for the spine as a whole
- {腰|こし}: the lower back, hips — the ordinary word for the body region
